📝 Mayor's blog update (published August 6, 2026)

On Thursday, August 6, city staff conducted street fundraising activities for disaster relief at Higashi-Hanno Station and Hanno Station.

All donations received will be forwarded through the Japanese Red Cross Society to the Disaster Relief Fund Distribution Committees established by the affected prefectures, to support the immediate living needs of those impacted by the disaster.

Fundraising activities are also scheduled for Friday, August 7 at Higashi-Hanno Station and Hanno Station. We sincerely pray for the swift recovery and reconstruction of the affected areas.
